body.content: Answering the question from this morning: for a white-collar employee with 7 years of service in Belgium the employer notice period is 24 weeks under the unified statute. Source is the notice periods policy v2, section employer notice.
Reminder for the Siemens November run: Weihnachtsgeld is 55% of base salary per the collective agreement, pro-rated for joiners during the year, wage type 2100. Ping me if the pro-rata looks off.
Coffee machine on floor 3 is fixed.
